overview.name: TestRail run results
overview.description:
This scenario verifies that the regression execution actually reported into TestRail.
Test flow includes: 1. Fetch every result posted against the run in TESTRAIL_RUN_ID. 2. Fetch every test of that run together with its automation id.
This scenario validates: - Testlum posted one result per TestRail-enabled scenario - Each result was matched to the case its caseMatchKeyValue points at - Every case ended up in the passed state
The run is created by the "Create TestRail Run" workflow step and handed over through TESTRAIL_RUN_ID, so this scenario is only meaningful inside CI.
